reason: A cloud synchronization plugin for backing up, restoring, and reconciling DSH configuration, plugin metadata, and selected local plugin source across WebDAV, object storage, and GitHub Gist.

summaries.zh: 用于在 WebDAV、对象存储或 GitHub Gist 之间同步 DSH 配置、插件信息及选定的本地插件源码，并支持历史恢复与冲突处理。
summaries.en: Synchronizes DSH configuration, plugin metadata, and selected local plugin source across WebDAV, object storage, or GitHub Gist with history recovery and conflict handling.

capabilities: Synchronizes DSH configuration snapshots with WebDAV and object-storage services
Archives and restores selected local plugin source files
Reads and writes local DSH profile and plugin installation state
Connects to GitHub Gist using authorization or a token
Checks GitHub Releases and installs user-confirmed plugin updates
Maintains sync history and supports conflict resolution and rollback
